crime_highlights: She and a friend, Z.M., had been picked up by the offender and a friend in Kelowna
M.F. and Z.M. stayed with the offender and his friend for approximately seven days in the motel room
M.F. received a tearing type injury
rationale_highlights: He has apparently had a difficult childhood of his own and no appreciable advantages to enable him to rise above the issues he faced during his formative years
I accept that his aboriginal heritage is a significant factor to be taken into account
that factor recedes in importance to the need for denunciation and deterrence
note: Court says heritage recedes; no explicit reduction in culpability stated.

crime_highlights: Mr. Alfred had sexual intercourse with the complainant
the complainant was 13 years old and the defendant was 26 years old
he admitted the sexual contact as alleged and admitted that he knew the complainant's age
rationale_highlights: I must take account of this man's background and circumstances as they reflect quite regrettable experiences growing up as an Aboriginal person
I am also concerned that the sentence this Court imposes does not have a destructive effect upon him
Those considerations call for restraint in the sentencing process
it must be tempered and restrained to address the concerns I have articulated
note: No victim impact information in decision.

crime_highlights: On September 26, 2018, the accused was convicted of one count of sexual interference contrary to s. 151 of the Criminal Code
the accused, on two occasions, touched the developing breasts of his then 11‑year‑old stepdaughter
The offences took place in the accused's home while he was parenting his stepdaughter and others, and while he was in a position of trust and authority
rationale_highlights: His mother and grandmother were subjected to the exigencies of the residential school program
I have also considered your extremely difficult upbringing and tragic and problematic life prior to this offence having taken place
this is a rare example of a case where incarceration is not the answer
note: Suspended sentence; no victim harm described in crime paragraphs.
